description: Actual signed Release v1.18 installs fresh and launches as a non-debuggable app.
Fresh release has working empty Favorites and Recent pages.
Release shows Boeing 757 in the Engine Start toolbar and checks the next required row.
Release renders the bundled four-page Boeing PDF while offline.
Release check persists after force-stop and cold restart.
Release Favorites/Recent shortcuts show model names and return to their originating list.
Release reset cancellation retains checks; confirmation clears them while keeping favorites.
Actual signed release keeps nested Back navigation working after Home Back and launcher re-entry.
